gizmo.title: Pahu Hana
gizmo.description: He poloka poʻo liʻiliʻi me ke kaila.

configure.title: Hōʻailona
configure.description: Hōʻailona i hōʻike ʻia me ka pahu hana.

configure.title: Lepili pahu hana
configure.description: Lepili i hōʻike ʻia ma ka pahu hana.

configure.title: ʻAʻohe Hoʻoluʻu
configure.description: E pale i ka hoʻopili ʻia ʻana o nā waihoʻoluʻu i ka hōʻailona.
